hints.title: Upper Bound Subtraction
hints.text: Count subarrays with maximum at most right, and subtract subarrays with maximum at most left minus one.

hints.title: Contiguous Run Lengths
hints.text: For a fixed bound, any contiguous segment of numbers <= bound contributes L * (L + 1) // 2 subarrays.

hints.title: Linear Accumulator Helper
hints.text: Define a helper count(bound) that iterates through nums, resets run length on values > bound, and adds current run length to the total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Two linear passes computing at-most subarray counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all O(N^2) subarrays with range maximum queries takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant auxiliary space O(1) with running accumulator.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply inclusion-exclusion on upper-bounded subarray counts.
